fp_estimate.method: 29/29 sampled wallets drawn from the non-structural class were human-like (aged nonce, NFT/DeFi history, ladders, IDMD holdings); all farm-like samples came from the structurally pre-identified groups; the structural scan over all 360 (shared tiny-EOA funder, in-cluster peel chain, identical nonce/date pairs, sequential roots) found ~36 members

extrapolation_to_unnamed_same_clusters.assumption: a wallet's nonce at deposit is the bridge: every named FP is nonce>=20; among UNNAMED members of disputed clusters 994/3,389 are nonce>=20, 497 nonce 1-19, 1,898 nonce 0; undisputed farms reuse aged wallets at only 365/7,824=4.7%, so the 29% aged share in disputed clusters is mostly organic
extrapolation_to_unnamed_same_clusters.estimate: unnamed nonce>=20: ~70-85% FP -> 700-850; nonce 1-19: ~40% -> ~200; nonce 0: ~10% -> ~190 (a fresh wallet made for the game by a human is indistinguishable from a farm wallet); total unnamed FP ~1,050-1,250 + ~305 named = ~1,350-1,550 wallets = 12-13% of the 11,573 flagged, concentrated in c7 (~600), c6 (~100), small round/odd clusters (~350), late 0.05 waves (~200)
extrapolation_to_unnamed_same_clusters.caveat: exchange-hub 1.x ladders (248) and c6's 721 nonce-0 members remain farm-like by this bridge; the estimate is wallets, not points (these FPs are mostly 0.05-0.2 ETH depositors, <1.5% of points)
